verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows a generic `createTimeOffRequest` MCP tool for submitting time-off requests and broad payroll capability claims, but nothing about defining PTO policies, accrual rules, or approval workflows, nor documentation that such policies automatically feed into payroll runs. missing for 10: PTO policy/accrual configuration, approval workflow setup, explicit link showing accrued/approved time-off auto-syncing to payroll, independent corroboration.
